subject: outcome tables to APA style in Word?

messages.author: 712207b40d408846
messages.subject: outcome tables to APA style in Word?
parts:
Hi all,

Can anyone tell me how to export results from lavaan to APA style tables in a Word file? I saw the semTable function online, but it says LaTex, which I do not use. The apaTables package offers regression results to publishable form tables in Word, so I wonder if there is a package or function like that for lavaan results.

apa.reg.table(object,filename="WordFileName.doc")

semTable(object, file = NULL, params = "all", fit = c("chi-square", "cfi","tli", "rmsea"), 
         names_fit = fit, standardized = FALSE,
         names_upper = TRUE, single_spaced = TRUE, type = "latex",
         group = NULL, longtable = FALSE)

Thanks in advance,
AvidLavaanUser

messages.author: 9b7a59c6f2d552cc
messages.subject: Re: outcome tables to APA style in Word?
parts:
Both jamovi (https://www.jamovi.org/) and JASP (https://jasp-stats.org/) create APA ready output and both have based their implementation of CFA on lavaan
try them
